name: Monthly Pension for the Maintenance of the Parents of the Martyred Soldier of the Army
benefit: - A pension of ₹10,000 per month is provided to the parents of martyred soldiers.
_eligibility_text: 1. The martyred soldier must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be the mother or father of a martyred soldier. 1. The martyred soldier whose death has been recognized as a battle casualty by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The annual income of the applicant's parents must be less than ₹10,000.
